timeline.caption: Drift revives QQ and WeChat drift bottles as a tiny shared story: one six-word beginning and one six-word ending.
Local sandbox recording, AI checks off, synthetic guest identities. Catch a beginning, unfold the note over the sea, write six words, save the shared postcard, then optionally pass on a beginning.
We now switch to the original writer in the same recorded run. Idle waiting has been cut.
The original writer opens the same canonical postcard from their collection without refreshing. Local sandbox, AI checks off, synthetic writers.
SpacetimeDB holds the exclusive catch, validates completion and returns the canonical postcard to both writers through live subscriptions. Ten-writer network checks passed after an ID-collision fix.

Separate hosted evidence: this real postcard passed Claude checks. Haiku checks content; Sonnet can suggest an angle without filling the ending. The development moderation evaluation matched 35 of 36 synthetic labels, with agent review.
Figma Make helped refine the quiet pool and returned-story states. We inspected the first prototype, revised its oversized paper, and implemented the selected design decision in the game.
The native eight-page Figma Slides deck includes the four-stage log, code links and a Make embed that we exercised inside the presentation. Both Figma files allow link viewing.

Mana built Bottle Kitchen, a working preparation app with seven themes, six-word validation, review progress and JSON export. It keeps drafts in the visitor's browser; human starter inventory is still empty.

Production export stays locked until all seven themes have twenty reviewed lines and the team attests authorship. We downloaded a real synthetic draft: Drift accepted its structure and refused production installation.

Image credits: sea by Vyacheslav Argenberg, CC BY 4.0; paper ball by Army1987, CC BY-SA 3.0; paper texture by D Sharon Pruitt, CC BY 2.0. Source links, licenses and changes are on the game's Image credits page and in the video description.
Try the deployed Drift game. Real-phone checks, independent moderation review and a human pilot remain. The private source repository still needs judge access.
